channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The clearest wins this period are infrastructure-linked: a DDEC-tied advisory committee advancing a Mercedita Airport master plan alongside $2.9M/$15.6M taxiway and rehab investment, a $9.6M request to rehabilitate northern water wells ahead of drought risk, a fiscal oversight board release of roughly $3.7M to UPR on milestone completion, and a record tourism year with hotel occupancy at 72.7%. Real risks persist: multiple independent economic indices (DDEC, coincident/leading) confirm Puerto Rico remains in a mild recession, a harbor-pilot dispute forced an emergency LNG workaround that tripled San Juan power-plant generation costs, and more than $8 billion in Hurricane Maria reconstruction funds remain unobligated nine years after landfall.
